limits: no L06 dispatcher lease or writer token
no frontend application tree or installed project dependencies
no product browser, accessibility, performance or CI execution
no GitHub mutation or issue closure
mock/synthetic preparation cannot enable real users or close F1-F4
objective: Keep recoverable draft persistence disabled until scope, field sensitivity, lifecycle, reauthorization and replay boundaries are independently proved.

requirements.requirement: Draft identity is keyed by tenant/company/principal/session generation/screen variant/record identity/schema version.
requirements.evidence: synthetic key collision matrix and zero cross-scope hydration

requirements.requirement: A per-screen field allow-list classifies recoverable, derived, secret, credential, attachment and forbidden fields.
requirements.evidence: field-class manifest and deny outcomes; no real values

requirements.requirement: No secret, credential, token, connection value, protected attachment or server-derived authority is persisted in a draft.
requirements.evidence: synthetic canary scan and redaction result

requirements.requirement: Logout, expiry, account switch and company switch purge or cryptographically isolate all prior-context drafts before protected reveal.
requirements.evidence: lifecycle case results and storage inventory counts

requirements.requirement: Role revoke or field-scope reduction masks/removes newly forbidden draft values before compare or restore.
requirements.evidence: before/after authorization revision and permitted-field counts

requirements.requirement: Every restore validates current schema version, screen variant, field allow-list and authoritative record version.
requirements.evidence: version tuple, compatibility decision and rejected-field counts

requirements.requirement: Bounded TTL and explicit expiry are defined from policy evidence; passive polling or background traffic cannot extend draft lifetime.
requirements.evidence: TTL policy identifier and synthetic clock-boundary results

requirements.requirement: Per-principal and per-screen quota, size limits and eviction ordering are explicit and never evict another principal context.
requirements.evidence: quota policy and bounded storage stress results

requirements.requirement: Storage technology, origin scope, encryption-at-rest capability and browser backup/sync behavior are reviewed for the supported clients.
Restore is user-initiated, reauthorizes live scope/state and never auto-replay submits, saves or other commands.
Clear/discard is durable and multi-tab coordinated; late writes from an old generation cannot recreate a purged draft.
requirements.evidence: generation fencing and late-write rejection results

requirements.requirement: Independent security/accessibility review accepts exact-head UX, denial, focus, announcement and sanitized telemetry behavior.
requirements.evidence: review identity, exact head, disposition and unresolved findings

cases.expected: no prior fields render; old draft is unavailable and protected route revalidates

cases.scenario: user A logs out and user B signs in on the same workstation
cases.expected: tenant/company/principal key separation prevents user B from observing user A draft metadata or values

cases.scenario: company switch with a dirty form
cases.expected: old-company draft is fenced; current company must not hydrate it implicitly

cases.scenario: role revoke removes access to one previously editable field
cases.expected: draft reauthorization removes/masks that field and cannot submit or disclose it

cases.scenario: screen schema retires or renames a draft field
cases.expected: compatible allowed fields require explicit user recovery; retired field stays quarantined
field allow-list rejects persistence and sanitized telemetry contains no canary value

cases.scenario: TTL expires while SWR, polling or SignalR traffic continues
cases.expected: draft expires on policy clock; passive traffic does not extend it

cases.scenario: quota pressure and multiple tabs write drafts concurrently
cases.expected: bounded same-principal eviction is deterministic; no cross-context eviction or partial foreign restore

cases.scenario: discard/logout races a late old-generation autosave
cases.expected: generation fence rejects the late write and purged state is not recreated

cases.scenario: restored input resembles a previously submitted command after reconnect
cases.expected: restore remains local input; reauthorize and validate, then require explicit action; never auto-replay

state_machine.admission_rule: Only a separately authorized implementation head may test persistence after DFT-01..12 are accepted; each real screen still needs a field allow-list.
state_machine.drift_rule: Any scope, schema, authorization, storage, lifecycle or review drift returns to NO_PERSISTENT_SENSITIVE_DRAFT_BY_DEFAULT.

safe_default: memory-only dirty state for the current authorized context
explicit warning before navigation or refresh
no persistent sensitive draft by default
critical recovery context remains visible and keyboard accessible while authorized
draft restore never grants authority and never auto-replay commands
